metadata.note: Pre-flood graph uses all OSM roads; post-flood graph removes roads whose midpoint lies inside flood_mask.tif. Because the SAR flood mask was shown not to contain the GLOF signal (see outputs/diagnostics/aoi_backscatter_diagnostics.json), the 'cut_off' flags here reflect the preliminary, under rebuild, not the real event. The machinery is correct; the input is not.
